message: 努力預金の満了

name: Synn
message: 「Good work out there~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good work out there~」

name: Misa
message: 「You came back right on schedule. Just as expected of my rival, I suppose.」

name: Synn
message: 「Being rivals has nothing to do with it. How was your break?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I went around visiting shops with Jiiya. It was su~per fun.」

name: Misa
message: 「I went with Shio. We got some great shopping done.」

name: Synn
message: 「Glad to hear it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are you going to walk around by yourself, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~~. Probably, yeah. Though it'd be nice if I could find Eddy.」

name: Misa
message: 「How lonely. Why don't you ask Nanaka-san along or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe I will, if our breaks line up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Things are getting pretty heated between you two~」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「What's going on?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Senpai. Good work out there.」
Wait a second? Coming back at this timing means--

name: Ria
message: 「Oh. Are you guys on break too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President and I were, just until a moment ago.」

name: Misa
message: 「You said 'too,' which means, could it be...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep♪ My break starts right now.\s07」
Ooh. Could this be my chance? If Ria-senpai is on break too, maybe we can walk around together.
Alright, I'll go ahead and ask her out first.

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Synn-kun. Want to walk around KiraFes together?」

name: Synn
message: 「She beat me to the punch right out of the gate...」

name: Misa
message: 「Together with Onee-sama!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come along now, let's go get you changed. All the good boys and girls are looking forward to seeing Blackuma-san.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Wait, Sakura-kun!! With Onee-sama, nooo~~」
Misa gets dragged away by Lolotte.
Lolotte is amazing for being able to take the lead even though she's an underclassman.
Meanwhile, look at me... Hmph, as Student Council President and as a man, I can't let things stay like this.
All right! Today's the day I take the lead!

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, let's go together!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai. Is there anywhere you want to go? Anywhere is fine.」
First, I'll show off how generous and broad-minded I am.

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~」

name: Synn
message: 「To the depths of the earth, or the ends of the sky.」

name: Ria
message: 「I want you to decide, Synn-kun.\s04」
Guh. She hits me with that right off the bat?!
However, I've already checked out where Ria-senpai wants to go.

name: Synn
message: 「Got it! Leave it to me!」

name: Ria
message: 「Since we came to Prier, does that mean the Wagashi Club?」

name: Synn
message: 「Spot on.」
When it comes to Ria-senpai, wagashi is the only choice!

name: Ria
message: 「I was just helping out here a moment ago~」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugaaah. That's right!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu\s04 But you can't eat unless you're a customer, right♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Didn't you do any taste-testing or anything?」

name: Ria
message: 「Sampling and this go into separate stomachs!」
She gives a proud huff through her nose and puffs out her chest.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Welcome, President. How many will be in your party today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. Table for two, please.」

name: Ria
message: 「Here we are.\s04」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun was the one who brought me here♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, you shouldn't go blaming it on someone else like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez. Come on, Akane-chan.」
Senpai is being misunderstood! I'd better back her up quick!

name: Synn
message: 「It's just like Ria-senpai says. I'm the one who decided on this place.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's no good, Prez. If you don't teach her about things besides traditional sweets every once in a while, she'll stay a sheltered little rich girl forever, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Akane-chan. You're making it sound like traditional sweets are the only thing I know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「And isn't that true?」

name: Ria
message: 「No it isn't!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You sure do try to look cool in front of Prez, don't you, Rii-a.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, is she different normally?」

name: Ria
message: 「No! Stop right there!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sorry about that. Looks like the rest is a secret.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... Now I'm curious.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's something you don't need to know about, Synn-kun!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Then again, maybe you already know all about it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun! Hurry up and pick something from the menu!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes! U-Umm...」
Urgh... Aren't traditional Japanese sweets supposed to be things like dorayaki or manju?
The menu is full of regional names and unfamiliar kanji, so I have no idea which ones are actually good.
At times like this, it's time for my ultimate secret technique.

name: Synn
message: 「I'll have today's recommendation!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Alrighty. Have some tea while you wait.」
Setting down hot Japanese tea, Misasagi-senpai headed back into the kitchen.

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez. Come on, Akane-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「You two really get along well, don't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if we're friends, that's going too far!」
Ria-senpai puffs out her cheeks in annoyance.
Seeing Senpai get wrapped around someone's finger like that is really refreshing~.

name: Ria
message: 「First Akane-chan, and now my big sister. They do that kind of stuff on purpose.」

name: Synn
message: 「That just shows how much they dote on you, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「That doesn't make me happy at all~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what kind of thing would make you happy?」

name: Ria
message: 「I want to be pampered wholeheartedly, like doting on a puppy~」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe. Will you pamper me, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? M-Me?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah!」
Pamper Senpai...?
What am I even supposed to do to pamper her?
Like doting on a puppy wholeheartedly...
Tickling around the neck, putting on a collar, throwing a frisbee...
Ugh, I can only come up with weird stuff!

name: Ria
message: 「Hehehe. Getting all troubled over it, you're so cute.\s04」
She pats my head, ending up pampering me instead.
I get it!

name: Ria
message: 「Huh, Synn-kun!?」

name: Synn
message: 「The~re, there. Good girl, good girl.」
I pat her head right back.

name: Ria
message: 「H-Hey~~! No fair, that's a senpai-only privilege!」

name: Synn
message: 「You said you wanted to be pampered, didn't you!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's that, and this is this~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about this~!」
Out of desperation, I tickle her neck.

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That tickles~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What are the two of you up to?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Two orders of special kuzumochi, sorry to keep you waiting.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「My, you two certainly get along wonderfully.」

name: Synn
message: 「Compared to how close you and Ria-senpai are, we still have a long way to go...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Mister President. Could it be you're feeling jealous?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, I'm not!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. Why don't you go 'aaah' and feed each other?♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, that might actually be a great idea~~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Even you, Senpai!?」
Am I just going to blush and get flustered again?
If I do, it'll just be the same old routine. I can't let them take the initiative here!
Thinking that, I used a toothpick to bring a piece of kuzumochi up to Ria-senpai's mouth.

name: Synn
message: 「Here, open up and say aaah.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my, well now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, say aaah!」

name: Ria
message: 「M-Me? I'm the one being fed~~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Enjoy your treat♪」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. Just give in, Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「No way! This is way too embarrassing~~」

name: Synn
message: 「You're always doing embarrassing stuff like this to me, aren't you?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Always...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Saying 'aaah' is a senpai's privilege! So you're not allowed to do it, Synn-kun!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Say ahh~」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If you're not gonna do it, Rii-a, I'll gladly take it myself.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's even worse! Jeez, fine, I get it!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You really are a handful, aren't you.」
Steeling herself, Ria-senpai turned to face me, closed her eyes, and opened her mouth.
Having her do this for me is pretty embarrassing, though it actually makes me kind of happy too.
Slowly, I guided the kuzumochi into Senpai's mouth.

name: Ria
message: 「Nom... munch, munch.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is it good?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah\s07 It's delicious♪」
In a complete turnaround, her face lit up brightly.
With a hand pressed to her cheek, she savored the treat with an enchanted expression.

name: Synn
message: 「Here's one more, then.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahh~, nom♪」
Seeing her eat it with such delight makes even me happy, and I'm just the one feeding her.
I think I'm starting to understand why Ria-senpai always wants to do this.

name: Ria
message: 「Mmmm\s07 So good.\s04」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You sure look happy.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, it's way, waaaay better than during the taste test.\s04」
Once you get used to it, it's really no big deal.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a second, so you really did eat some earlier.」

name: Ria
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. Looks like the president's one step ahead of you.」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun's share is all gone...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Isn't that different from the one I gave Rii-a earlier?」

name: Synn
message: 「That one was mine?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan. Just one more, please.\s01」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Thanks for your patronage♪」
I sip my tea and let out a sigh of relief.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting.」

name: Ria
message: 「So fast!!」
Ria-senpai's portion came along as a freebie too.
This time, without feeding each other, we take our time savoring them.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Is it delicious?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, I'm glad.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hey, Rii-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hm?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You really do like younger boys, don't you, Rii-a?」

name: Ria
message: 「Akane-chan, why would you say something like--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, you're showing a different smile than usual, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「R-Really...?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You've never once fed me like that, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Really?」
That's kind of surprising. So it's not something she normally does.

name: Ria
message: 「I told you earlier, didn't I? Feeding someone is a senpai's privilege, so I don't do it for people my own age.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「How mean.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Still, have you ever done the same thing for anyone else?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not something you just do with anybody, right? Even I choose who I do it with carefully.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Does that mean--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Rii-a treats the President as someone special, doesn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course♪ After all, Synn-kun is my cute little junior.」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, that's all it is... *sigh*」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. I'm going to step out to the restroom for a moment.」
Taking advantage of the moment Ria-senpai left her seat, Misasagi-senpai smoothly brought her folding fan up to my ear.

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's no need to feel down. If there's nobody else, she's basically saying without realizing it that you're her one and only, President.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You went to all the trouble of going on a date, so are you really going to settle for just the Wagashi Club?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's not a date.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Surely there are plenty of other fun shops around.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, yes, but...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Pull yourself together!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Being a senior or a junior doesn't matter one bit when it comes to love.」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Love!?」
Dates and love--that makes it sound like I have a crush on Ria-senpai.

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai and I are just fellow members of the Student Council, we don't have any special feelings like--」
No special feelings?
Do I really not? I'm not sure.
Still, being with Ria-senpai is fun, and if possible, I want to spend even more time with her.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Having the same goals. Being able to savor the same joys. And sharing the same hardships.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「A relationship like that truly makes me envious.」

name: Synn
message: 「Between Ria-senpai and me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee. The one who's most jealous might actually be me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks for waiting~. Well, next up--」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai. Since we're here, want to look around the other spots too?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh? Ah, sure. Sounds good~」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much for the meal. Um, how much do we owe--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's on the house. In exchange, do your best until the very end.」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks~~♪ That's why I love you, Akane-chan!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You're paying, though, Rii-a. You ate quite a lot, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ugh! Meanie!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai, thank you so much!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Think nothing of it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Delicious rice balls right here~」

name: Ria
message: 「Thank you~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We have oden too~」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, hey, Synn-kun! Let's get some pork soup too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hot, hot!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez! Don't rush.\s04」
We ate the food being served at headquarters.

name: Synn
message: 「Tennouji, aye!」

name: Ria
message: 「Tennouji, aye!」
We watched a live performance by a band we knew, jumping up and down while chanting along together.

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, come on, Prez. Put these balloons in here--」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! Whoa! Stop it~~!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ta-da! The big-boob duo!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sally-chan, your voice is too loud~~!\s03」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek!」

name: Ria
message: 「Kyaaah!」
If a guy and a girl are having a good time together, it wouldn't be weird for people to call it a date.
Actually, I've never been on a date before so I don't really know, but maybe it feels something like this.
The bell rings, signaling the end of our fun time together.

name: Ria
message: 「Ehhh? Is it that time already?」

name: Synn
message: 「Break time is almost over, isn't it.」
After this, Ria-senpai and I will head back to our respective posts.
We only have a tiny bit of time left to be together.
Thinking about that suddenly made my chest ache.
I want to stay with Ria-senpai even longer.

name: Ria
message: 「You look lonely, Synn-kun.」

name: Ria
message: 「You've got a reluctant look in your eyes.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder how you can tell.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. Your senpai can see right through everything.」
Normally I'd feel frustrated or like she got the better of me, but this time, having her see right through me felt really comforting.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm glad you feel bummed about it. Because I was feeling the exact same way.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, me too.」
Ah, I see. That's why this sense of connection feels so good.

name: Ria
message: 「I wish break time could last longer, wayyy longer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha.」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks for hanging out with me. It was super fun.」
I don't want this moment to end right here.
One more time. Just once more. Even if it's only this once.
I want to go to a park or head into town with Ria-senpai and go on a proper date.
Those feelings came bubbling up inside me.
But...
There's no way I can just blurt out, 'Let's go on a date again!'
Besides, I don't even know if this counts as a date in the first place.
Ugh... My heart's pounding so hard I can't even meet her eyes.

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, right! Let me do this before I forget.」
Saying that, what she pulled out was her usual stamp.
Still, all we did right now was hang out together, so I don't think that really warrants getting a stamp.

name: Ria
message: 「This is for all the hard work you put in when I wasn't looking♪」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So many...!?」

name: Ria
message: 「--And lastly,」

name: Ria
message: 「To celebrate KiraFes being a success, okay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... It's not over yet, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't know if I'll get another chance to stamp it like this before it ends. So, it's an advance stamp.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, after seeing everything we just did, you already know the answer, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「A festival everyone can enjoy, created by everyone working together. That's the Shooting Star Kirakira Festival.」

name: Ria
message: 「The students, the shopping district folks, and the guests were all sparkling so brightly, weren't they?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Ria
message: 「That makes it more than a huge success, right♪ Good job working so hard.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... Amazing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「This is amazing, Synn-kun! Your stamps are completely full~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha... To think it'd actually fill up.」

name: Ria
message: 「Congratulations! It's the first grand achievement of my stamp-giving career~~」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean it's an unprecedented feat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep♪ After all, you're the only one I ever issued one to, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat. So that's how it was~」
No wonder it's a first.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, why only me? I totally assumed you were handing them out to everyone.」

name: Ria
message: 「Take a good, close look. I can only give this stamp card to someone special.」

name: Synn
message: 「For Student Council President Use Only.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. That's right!」
So it's like a handover from one Student Council President to the next.

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean you had it last year, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope. I came up with it starting this year.」
So she's the first one!

name: Ria
message: 「Now then. Do you remember what happens when all the stamps are filled in?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, yes. It's the thing where you'll grant any wish I want, right, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Exactly♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Anything...」
A-Anything goes?!
Having no limits actually makes it harder to decide what to wish for.
I don't know if there'll be a next time, so this might be my last chance.
If it's come to this, maybe something I wouldn't normally be able to ask for--

name: Ria
message: 「Anything at all--you can do whatever you want.\s04」
Ugh, is Ria-senpai saying that on purpose?
When she puts it like that, it really makes me want to ask for something weird.
She might even grant a naughty wish if I asked...
No, no, bad idea!
She's probably only letting her guard down this much because she trusts me!
I can't ruin all the trust we've built up until now right here.
I don't know why, but I don't want Ria-senpai to hate me.
Right now, that feeling is just growing stronger and stronger.
If I'm going to make a wish, it has to be something that'll bring me even closer to Ria-senpai.
...Wait a second? That's it! Now's my only chance to say it!

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Have you decided?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-W-Well! I-I-I-I-I, I w-w--!」

name: Ria
message: 「Calm down and take a deep breath♪ Deep breath♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Inhale... exhale...」

name: Ria
message: 「Okay, go ahead.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai! Would you like to go out somewhere with me again sometime?!」
I-Is that a no!?

name: Ria
message: 「Are you sure that's what you want to wish for?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're really okay with just that?」

name: Synn
message: 「A man never goes back on his word!」
A tense moment. Whatever happens, happens!

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Of course it's okay.」

name: Synn
message: 「Awesooome!」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. You could've asked for something way bigger, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「Like what kind of wish?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well... um...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's a secret♪」
She dodged the question.

name: Ria
message: 「Still, that last stamp is just a reservation, so you have to keep working hard until KiraFes is over, got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes, ma'am!」
Yes! I managed to get Ria-senpai to promise to go on a date with me.

name: Synn
message: 「All riiight! Well then, I'm heading off!」

name: Ria
message: 「Make sure you don't get hurt~」
